arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS online_transactions_march_2019 FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND date >= '2019-03-01' AND date < '2019-04-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions of type 'Online Transaction' dated in March 2019.
assumptions: 'Online' means transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' (not the merchant location city = 'ONLINE').
March 2019 is 2019-03-01 up to but not including 2019-04-01, all transactions counted whether or not they carry a fraud label.
